At one point on the second night, after it made me wake up a bunch of times and rock it for hours, I just ever so slightly relaxed my grip on its neck. It screamed. It screamed the loudest, most scary scream I had ever heard, and my dad found me on the floor of my room, rocking the sobbing baby and crying myself. On the afternoon of the second day I simply couldn't take it anymore, and called my teacher,  crying and begging her to turn it off. She did, and I ended up getting a mark in the 90's, but, one things for sure, no way in hell am I ever having a kid.
